summary.overall_coverage_pct: float: root-level hierarchical weighted coverage percentage
summary.total_goals: int: total number of leaf goals in the verification plan
summary.goals_met: int: number of goals where achieved coverage >= goal threshold
summary.goals_failed: int: number of goals where achieved coverage < goal threshold

metrics._keying: One entry per leaf node in the verification plan, keyed by the vplan leaf name

<vplan_leaf_name>.covered_count: int: number of covered items after exclusions
<vplan_leaf_name>.uncovered_items: list: identifiers of uncovered items (see identifier_formats)

covergroups._keying: One entry per covergroup, keyed by covergroup name from the database

components._keying: One entry per coverpoint or cross within the covergroup

<component_name>.total_count: int: total number of bins after exclusions

hierarchy._keying: One entry per node in the vplan tree (root, intermediate, and leaf nodes)

<node_name>.children: list of string: child node names (empty list for leaves)

failed_goals._type: list of objects, one per failed goal

_element.metric: string: vplan leaf name of the failed goal
_element.goal_pct: float: required goal percentage from vplan

identifier_formats.branch: string branch IDs as stored in the database

computation_rules.run_filtering: Only runs with status PASSED in the run_metadata table contribute to merged results.
computation_rules.code_coverage_merge: A code coverage item (line, branch, or toggle) is considered covered if it was hit in any valid run.
computation_rules.functional_bin_coverage: For functional coverage bins, hit counts are summed across all valid runs. A bin is covered when its total hit count meets or exceeds the coverpoint threshold.
computation_rules.cross_coverage_total: The total number of bins for a cross is the full set of combinations of its component coverpoint bins, minus any excluded bins.
computation_rules.covergroup_coverage: Arithmetic mean of all component (coverpoint and cross) coverage percentages within the covergroup.
computation_rules.exclusion_application: Excluded items are removed from both total and covered counts. FSM state exclusions with cascade also remove all transitions involving the excluded state.
computation_rules.hierarchical_rollup: Leaf nodes use the corresponding metric coverage percentage. Internal nodes use the weighted average of their children using the weights from the vplan.
